description.value: A provincial government-operated retail liquor store serving Qualicum Beach on Vancouver Island, stocking wine, beer, spirits, ciders, and non-alcoholic beverages. As a Crown corporation outlet, it carries a broad and consistent selection including BC VQA wines and local craft beer. Touring cyclists resupplying for an evening camp or cottage stay will find it a reliable stop in the Qualicum area.
